function_v0.doc:
Sends the full balance of `token` to the two recipients.

Any account can call this function. The function does not read the
caller and does not require the authorization of the caller.

The recipient with the larger share gets
`floor(balance * bps / 10000)`. The other recipient gets the rest.
The rounding remainder, which is smaller than one unit of the token,
always goes to the recipient with the smaller share. If the two shares
are equal, the remainder goes to `recipient_b`.

Returns the two amounts in constructor order.
function_v0.name: withdraw
